title: Extraction of Surface-Community DNA from Macroalgal Thalli
author: Torsten Thomas

steps.title: Collect macroalgal thalli
steps.instruction: Collect several macroalgal thalli (e.g., Ulva sp.) and place them into a bag or container filled with seawater.

steps.title: Chop thalli into pieces
steps.instruction: Cut the thalli into pieces roughly 2–4 cm in length and width.

steps.title: Wash thalli three times
steps.instruction: Wash the thalli three times, each wash lasting 1–2 min with CMFSW, ensuring that smaller fragments and non‑algal material are removed.

steps.title: Weigh wet thalli
steps.instruction: Using a balance, weigh out 10–20 g of wet‑weight (drip‑dry) thalli into a petri dish.

steps.title: Incubate with enzyme cleaner
steps.instruction: Transfer the thallus material into a sterile 50 mL Falcon tube containing 30 mL CMFSW and 300 µL of 3 M Multi‑Enzyme Cleaner (article number 70500). Shake gently to coat the surface and incubate at room temperature for 30–180 min.

steps.title: Assess cleaning efficacy
steps.instruction: Examine the thalli by microscopy to check removal of microbial cells and surface integrity. If cleaning is insufficient, increase the Multi‑Enzyme Cleaner dilution (e.g., 30 µL or 3 µL of 3 M cleaner in 30 mL CMFSW) or extend the incubation time.

steps.title: Transfer and optionally filter liquid
steps.instruction: Transfer the liquid to one or two new 50 mL Falcon tubes, keeping the volume ≤20 mL and avoiding transfer of thallus material. Optionally filter the liquid through a sterile 125 µm sieve or a 0.8 µm filter.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of phenol : chloroform : isoamyl alcohol (25 : 24 : 1) to the supernatant and shake gently but thoroughly. Centrifuge 5 min at 2,000 × g. Transfer the aqueous phase to a sterile SS‑34 tube (or equivalent).

steps.title: First DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: To the aqueous phase, add 1/10 volume of 3 M sodium acetate and 3 volumes of 95 % ethanol. Shake gently but thoroughly (a white precipitate may appear). Incubate at –20 °C for at least 2 h, then centrifuge 30 min at 20,000 × g. Remove the supernatant.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol to the pellet, centrifuge 5 min at 20,000 × g, remove the supernatant and air‑dry the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in sterile water
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL sterile water and transfer the suspension to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Second DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1/10 volume of 3 M sodium acetate and 3 volumes of 95 % ethanol to the suspension. Shake gently but thoroughly (a white precipitate may appear). Incubate at –20 °C for at least 2 h, then centrifuge 30 min at 20,000 × g. Remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol to the pellet, centrifuge 5 min at 20,000 × g, remove the supernatant and air‑dry the pellet.

steps.title: Final resuspension in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 50–100 µL TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0).

steps.title: Verify DNA on gel
steps.instruction: Load approximately 1 µL of the extracted DNA onto an agarose gel to assess quality and quantity.
